Welcome to Neon Drift—an ultra-futuristic ML race where competitors adapt in real time to streaming chaos: concept drift, noisy signals, and adversarial obstacles. Watch who self-heals fastest and who keeps accuracy steady as the track keeps changing.

In this episode, we pit:
- DriftDash DQN
- Cortex Glide Transformer
- EntropySprinter Bayesian-BN
- RobustRover MetaRL
- GuardRail EnsembleNet
- QuantumTire Hybrid
- NoisyPathfinder DistillNet

Drop your pick in the comments: who should win the Grand Prix?
